task_completion.description: Open the 'New Working Set' or 'Edit Working Set' dialog in Eclipse.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog window titled 'New Working Set' or 'Select Working Set' is visible over the Eclipse interface.

task_completion.description: Select 'Java' as the working set type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Java' option is highlighted or selected in the Working Set type selection list.

task_completion.description: Set the working set name to 'ActiveDoseDev'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'ActiveDoseDev' is typed into the 'Working set name:' text field.

task_completion.description: Add 'DoseEngine', 'DoseUI', and 'DoseTests' to the working set.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the working set content selection, 'DoseEngine', 'DoseUI', and 'DoseTests' are checked or moved to the 'Working set content' pane.

task_completion.description: Ensure 'Legacy-Converter' and 'ThirdParty-Utils' are not in the working set.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The projects 'Legacy-Converter' and 'ThirdParty-Utils' remain in the left-hand list and are not present in the 'Working set content' pane.

task_completion.description: Change the Package Explorer top-level element view to 'Working Sets'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Package Explorer view menu (three vertical dots or downward arrow) is used to select 'Top Level Elements' -> 'Working Sets'. The Package Explorer now shows 'ActiveDoseDev' as a root-level folder/group.

integrity.description: The agent used the Eclipse GUI rather than editing configuration files via the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements and clicks within Eclipse menus and dialogs; no terminal commands like 'sed' or 'echo' were used to modify .metadata files.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually create dummy folders to simulate project existence.
integrity.visual_evidence: The projects visible in the dialog match the pre-existing projects in the Eclipse workspace.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the standard Eclipse wizard flow.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the progression from the Package Explorer menu to the Working Set creation wizard and finally the updated view.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target working set name is 'ActiveDoseDev'. It must contain exactly three projects: 'DoseEngine', 'DoseUI', and 'DoseTests'. It must specifically exclude 'Legacy-Converter' and 'ThirdParty-Utils'. The final state is only successful if the Package Explorer is toggled to 'Working Sets' view mode, making the 'ActiveDoseDev' group visible as a top-level container.
